stories.title: Define BroadcastContent, ContentMetadata, ContentPath, MimeType types with magic byte prefix and deserialize_broadcast_content()
stories.description: Define the structured inner payload types for broadcast content delivery per §18.11.9. BroadcastContent is the canonical inner payload format — what encrypted_content decrypts to. Wire format: BROADCAST_CONTENT_MAGIC (ASCII "SCP") ++ version_u8 ++ MessagePack(BroadcastContent). ContentPath is a validated URL path newtype that rejects traversal attacks, backslashes, null bytes, control chars, percent-encoded traversals, query strings, and fragments. MimeType is a validated MIME type newtype that rejects CRLF and control characters to prevent HTTP response splitting. deserialize_broadcast_content() implements the version detection algorithm: check magic prefix, read version byte, deserialize MessagePack; legacy payloads (no magic prefix) returned as raw bytes. ETag is SHA-256(body) hex-encoded.

stories.title: Implement path-indexed projection endpoint with SiteConfig, virtual host routing, MIME-aware serving, and security headers
stories.description: Implement path-based projection endpoints per §18.11.10 and §18.11.12. Each projected context is bound to a hostname via SiteConfig (node-local config, not governance-governed). The node performs virtual host routing — requests to that hostname resolve directly to the context's path index. The internal canonical path /scp/broadcast/<routing_id>/site/<path> is also available. Path resolution looks up the blob in the current deploy matching ContentMetadata.path, returns the raw body with declared Content-Type. Security headers are mandatory on all site responses: X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff, Content-Security-Policy (default 'self', configurable via SiteConfig.csp_override with validation against unsafe-eval/unsafe-inline/unsafe-hashes/wildcard */data:/blob:), X-Frame-Options: DENY, Strict-Transport-Security, Cross-Origin-Opener-Policy: same-origin, Cross-Origin-Embedder-Policy: require-corp, Referrer-Policy: same-origin, Permissions-Policy: camera=(), microphone=(), geolocation=(), payment=(). Cache behavior: assets with ContentMetadata.immutable: true get immutable 1-year cache, immutable: false (default) get max-age=0 must-revalidate with ETag, 404s get no-store. SiteConfig struct with hostname (RFC 1123 validated), index_path, max_assets_per_deploy, max_deploy_size_bytes, deploy_retention_count (max 8), csp_override. Duplicate and invalid hostnames across contexts rejected.

stories.title: Implement atomic deploys with deploy_id grouping, manifest blob, commit-time index build, and double-buffer retention
stories.description: Implement atomic deploy mechanics per §18.11.11. Assets are published as individual broadcast messages with deploy_id set during the publish phase — blob storage only, path index NOT updated. On commit, the node scans all blobs matching deploy_id, builds an immutable PathIndex (HashMap<ContentPath, BlobId>), stores a deploy manifest blob, and atomically swaps current_deploy_id via ArcSwap. HTTP handlers read current_deploy_id via ArcSwap::load() — lock-free, no contention. Double-buffer retention: current + previous deploy indexes in memory for in-flight request draining. Configurable retention count (default 2). Partial failure: orphaned blobs expire via TTL, path index never built, retry is clean slate. Deploy manifest blob persists path->blob_id mapping for restart recovery — loaded on enable_broadcast_projection(). Key rotation during deploy: mixed-epoch blobs are cryptographically sound. Per-context path index: Arc<ArcSwap<PathIndex>> per ProjectedContext. Resource limits: max 10,000 assets per deploy, max 512 MiB total deploy size, max 8 deploys retained.

stories.title: Add broadcastPublishAsset and broadcastPublishAssets to all FFI bridges and SDK bindings
stories.description: Add broadcastPublishAsset (single asset) and broadcastPublishAssets (batch) convenience methods to all FFI bridges and SDK bindings per §18.11.8 (amended) and ADR-042. Each method accepts a typed AssetEntry parameter (path: ContentPath, content_type: MimeType, body: bytes) — typed parameter prevents positional transposition. deploy_id is a separate parameter on broadcastPublishAssets. Returns { blobId, etag } where etag is SHA-256(body) hex-encoded. broadcastPublishAssets accepts a Vec<AssetEntry>, publishes all assets, then commits the deploy atomically. Content-hash dedup: if a blob with the same SHA-256(body) already exists in the current deploy_id, skip re-upload and return existing blobId. PyO3 bridge is the reference implementation; NAPI, UniFFI, and WASM bridges follow. WASM bridge reimplements ContentPath/MimeType validation locally per ADR-034. TypeScript and Python SDK wrappers provide idiomatic APIs over their respective bridges.
